title: Holcim Egypt restarts fifth cement production line
summary: Holcim Egypt restarts fifth cement production line
body_markdown:
**Egypt:** Holcim Egypt has recommissioned its fifth cement production line at its Ain Sokhna cement plant with an investment of US$24.2m, following a seven-year shutdown. The restarted line will reportedly create 560 direct and indirect jobs.


Industry Minister Khaled Hashem said that the government is encouraging cement producers to increase their use of alternative fuels (AF), particularly refuse-derived fuel (RDF).
